newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony denies reports of Sony Computer listing.
newsitem.headline: Sony denies reports of Sony Computer listing.

text.p: Sony Corp on Thursday denied reports that its unit Sony Computer Entertainment Inc would be listed on the stock exchange.

"Some media reported today that Sony Computer Entertainment Inc, a 50-50 joint venture of Sony Corp and Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc, will be listed on the stock exchange. Sony Corp would like to state that there are presently no plans to do so," Sony said in a statement.
It was not immediately clear what media reports Sony was referring to.
Sony Computer makes and sells the 32-bit PlayStation video game which has outsold its rivals since its launch in 1994.
